messages:
Sam (Docs): FYI docs linkcheck started failing after the MkDocs plugin bump. Broken fragment reported: /reference/api#rate-limits-quotas
CI-Bot: docs-ci | linkcheck failed
CI-Bot: FAIL: Broken fragment /reference/api -> #rate-limits-quotas (404)
Sam (Docs): the heading in reference/api.md is currently:
```
## Rate limits & quotas
```
Noah (Tech Writer): ah, mkdocs-slugify changed behavior and converts '&' -> 'and' in some modes. Old fragment used to be #rate-limits-quotas, new slug is #rate-limits-and-quotas
Ivy (DevEx): can we add an explicit HTML id on the heading so slug churn won't break user links? also add a redirect entry to preserve existing inbound URLs
Ethan (Eng): yep. I'll open a tiny PR that: 1) adds {#rate-limits-quotas} to the H2, 2) adds a redirect rule in mkdocs.yml, 3) updates any internal references to use the explicit id.
Ethan (Eng): heading patch:
```md
## Rate limits & quotas {#rate-limits-quotas}
```
Ethan (Eng): mkdocs.yml redirect section (using mkdocs-redirects plugin):
```yaml
plugins:
  - redirects:
      redirects:
        'reference/api/#rate-limits-quotas': 'reference/api/#rate-limits-and-quotas'
```
Noah (Tech Writer): also found an example in the "Rate-limited retries" snippet that links to the old fragment; will update that to the explicit id to be future-proof
Sam (Docs): can we add a soft-guard to the linkcheck job so it recognizes our redirects file and treats those fragments as allowed during the CI run? avoids noisy failures while we roll out fixes
Ivy (DevEx): yes. I can modify the linkcheck step to load mkdocs-redirects mapping and accept from->to fragment pairs. We'll still fail if neither target exists.
Ethan (Eng): PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/2314 (adds id + redirect + snippet updates)
CI-Bot: PR 2314 | checks started
Sam (Docs): once merged, let's add a short line in docs/migration/mkdocs_compat.md about slug behavior changes and recommend explicit ids for public-facing anchors
Noah (Tech Writer): I'll write the migration blurb and run a quick grep for common '&' headings across the repo to catch other likely hits
Ivy (DevEx): follow-ups: 1) merge PR 2314, 2) deploy docs, 3) run link audit for top 100 most-trafficked fragments. I'll schedule the audit for tomorrow morning.
Ethan (Eng): merged and deployed. CI green.
CI-Bot: docs site build 30s | SUCCESS
Sam (Docs): great work. I'll close the incident and start the anchor audit with Noah. Thanks :thumbsup:
Noah (Tech Writer): happy to help. will open any small PRs for other headings I find.
